headline.purpose: Double-ruled screen headers; local serif stack.

passage.purpose: Long text above 520px; use passage-phone at narrower widths.

label.purpose: Native sans controls; historical variable name --mono is not a monospace font.

shadows.name: flat-resting
shadows.purpose: Reviewed home and reading components at rest. Legacy hover shadows are excluded.

motion.name: press-transform
motion.purpose: Shared controls scale to .99 while pressed.

motion.name: control-colour
motion.value: background-color .16s ease-out, border-color .18s ease-out, color .18s ease-out

assets.provenance: Supplied preexisting company leaf assets; no generated imagery in this design turn.
assets.usage: Install icons and shared leaf mark; preserve aspect ratio.

notes: Palette primitives live only in DESIGN.md frontmatter. No additional tonal scales were introduced.
Dark theme uses the existing :root[data-theme="dark"] overrides in app.css; home navigation uses shade and ink in dark mode.
Component previews emulate is-pressed with :active; app pointer-event behavior remains in js/ui.js.
Legacy hard hover shadows and feedback glyph icons are not canonized. Preview snippets omit those defects.

components.name: Solid-ink button
components.description: Existing selected or pressed emphasis variant; the preview uses CSS active state in place of the app's pointer-event class.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:700 11px/1.4 var(--mono, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif);letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease-out,background-color .16s ease-out,color .18s ease-out;border:2px solid var(--ink,#183329);background:var(--ink,#183329);color:var(--paper,#fff)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#245d8c);outline-offset:3px;outline-color:var(--paper,#fff)}.ds-primary:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.99)}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.3}

components.name: Ruled button
components.description: Standard paper action with a strong rule; legacy hard hover shadow is intentionally not a system token.
components.css: .ds-ruled{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:700 11px/1.4 var(--mono, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif);letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease-out,background-color .16s ease-out,color .18s ease-out;border:2px solid var(--ink,#183329);background:var(--glass,rgba(255,255,255,.78));color:var(--ink,#183329)}.ds-ruled:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#245d8c);outline-offset:3px}.ds-ruled:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}.ds-ruled:active{background:var(--ink,#183329);color:var(--paper,#fff);transform:scale(.99)}.ds-ruled:disabled{opacity:.3}

components.name: Small thin button
components.description: Compact secondary actions, including Settings and passage tools.
components.css: .ds-thin{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:700 11px/1.4 var(--mono, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif);letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease-out,background-color .16s ease-out,color .18s ease-out;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;padding:8px 11px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink,#183329);background:var(--glass,rgba(255,255,255,.78));color:var(--ink,#183329)}.ds-thin:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#245d8c);outline-offset:3px}.ds-thin:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}.ds-thin:active{background:var(--ink,#183329);color:var(--paper,#fff);transform:scale(.99)}.ds-thin:disabled{opacity:.3}

components.name: Vocabulary home choice
components.description: One of five area-specific navigation fills; the remaining pairs are frontmatter tokens.
components.css: .ds-home{display:block;width:100%;min-height:68px;padding:20px;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--ink,#183329);border-radius:0;background:#e4f2e9;color:#175035;font:700 16px/1.2 var(--mono, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif);letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease-out}.ds-home:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#245d8c);outline-offset:3px}.ds-home:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}.ds-home:active{transform:scale(.99)}

components.name: Search field
components.description: Flexible 16px input with attached ink label and a two-pixel frame.
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;border:2px solid var(--ink,#183329);color:var(--ink,#183329)}.ds-search span{background:var(--ink,#183329);color:var(--paper,#fff);padding:11px;font:9px var(--mono, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif);letter-spacing:2px}.ds-search input{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:11px;font:16px var(--mono, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif);background:none;color:inherit;border:0;border-radius:0;caret-color:var(--accent,#176447)}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#245d8c);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Navigation row
components.description: A full-width library row with serif lesson text and pressed shade feedback.
components.css: .ds-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:11px 13px;text-align:left;background:var(--glass,rgba(255,255,255,.78));color:var(--ink,#183329);font:700 15px var(--serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Songti SC', serif);border:0;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease-out,background-color .16s ease-out}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#245d8c);outline-offset:3px}.ds-row:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)}.ds-row:active{background:var(--shade,#f0f5f2);transform:scale(.99)}

components.name: Inline definition
components.description: In-flow meaning panel; surrounding passage continuation is preserved by the app.
components.html:
astronomern.

narrative.overview: The learner app extends the existing Inspire company leaf identity with evergreen ink, lightly coloured learning choices and plain reading paper. Serif passages retain the feel of printed study material; native interface text keeps navigation distinct from the material being learned.
keyCharacteristics: White reading paper, evergreen structure and restrained area colours.
Square corners, precise rules and compact interface labels.
Serif reading, native sans interface text and local Chinese serif fallbacks.
Inline meanings and persistent yellow word highlights.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Reading prose stays on the paper surface; area colours belong to navigation and highlights belong to selected words.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Keep serif learning content and native sans navigation distinct; preserve the Chinese serif fallback where the component supplies it.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Carry hierarchy with border weight and tonal fill; do not add shadow elevation to the documented reading and home components.

dos: Do use the existing paper and leaf identity and the supplied company assets.
Do load `reader.css` after `app.css` and check the final cascade before copying a value.
Do keep meanings inline, preserve the passage continuation and expose Undo highlight.
Do preserve keyboard focus, safe-area padding, readable input sizes and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards or replace the company mark with new artwork.
Don't turn home area colours into correctness signals or colour entire reading passages.
Don't restore page entrance flashes or add downloaded fonts to this local-font system.
Don't promote legacy glyph icons, unused kickers or leftover hover shadows into new component rules.
